assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square albedo texture for an animated 3D water surface in a photographic printed-paper collage surfing game. Create a beautiful calm open-ocean water texture seen straight down, orthographic, completely filling the square. Ocean turquoise and petrol blue, subtle long fluid ripples, delicate sunlit aqua strokes and soft ink-like salt-speckled photographic print grain on matte paper. Most area is smooth rich marine blue-green, with restrained bright highlights. Consistent even lighting, low to medium contrast. This texture will be deformed into large waves in code, so it must NOT depict breaking waves or big waves itself. Seamless repeatable edges, visually even coverage with no dominant diagonal direction. No horizon, no land, no objects, no shadows, no white foam streaks, no torn edges, no folds, no creased paper, no stripes, no geometric polygons, no text. Premium warm sunset coastal game look with clean readable shapes rather than busy noisy water. Square full-bleed material texture, opaque.

Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: transparent distant coastal environment sprite for a photographic torn-paper collage surfing game. Input image 1 is the existing city reference: preserve its Mediterranean seaside identity, warm pastel houses, terracotta roofs, greenery and stone bell tower, but redesign the silhouette and proportions for a balanced distant low horizontal headland. Create ONE complete compact coastal town on a broad, LOW limestone promontory. Horizontal object about 2.2 times as wide as tall: 8-12 tightly grouped small buildings, ONE modest stone bell tower near the right third, tower never taller than twice the surrounding roofs, trees nestling between houses, terraces following the slope. The headland slopes gently down toward the left tip; on the right its pale sandy land tapers into a slender attached shore. A natural low rocky base, no sheer mountain wall. Entire object visible with generous transparent padding on every side, tower and coast must not be cropped. Match photographic magazine-cutout realism and tactile sun-faded print from the reference, warm golden evening light, slightly softened distant detail. A VERY THIN irregular ivory cut-paper contour, not a thick white sticker border. No broad blue ocean platform underneath: just a narrow ivory surf fringe hugging the foot of the rocks. No sky, no background, no horizon, no people, no boats, no UI, no text. Output one landscape image, truly transparent outside the entire coast. The town must feel nestled in a wide low promontory rather than piled into a skyscraper.

Full silhouette about 3.6 times wider than tall, broad gently curved shoulder, soft rounded crest spanning most of the width, a delicate white foam crown, beautiful clear teal face and few long aqua highlights.
